decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the necessary change to one reference-matching trial clip, with no omitted stale attributes.
Exact visual matching could encompass the caption font, but the supplied evidence does not reveal the reference font or establish that it replaces the existing brand-guideline font standard.

The reference-matching instruction could encompass caption color and effects, but the reference appearance is unavailable and the source does not explicitly replace the existing white-text-only and no-effects rules.
Matching a design-platform visual reference does not change the independent requirement to select moments that teach something or provide substantive value.
The visual reference instruction does not alter the requirement that each clip form a complete, independently understandable lesson or story.
The same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete eight-clip batch-source constraint and updates the trial context; the design reference does not establish another source-selection change.
The instruction to match a visual design reference does not modify the independent hook-quality requirement.
The source decision does not change the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits.
A one-clip reference-matching trial instruction does not change the separate ongoing target of 180 approved clips per month.
